title: Circuit evaluation transition function
statement: For a Boolean flag $e$, define the transition function of a two-work-tape machine on each state, input symbol, and pair of scanned work-tape symbols as follows. It reads input symbols in pairs and rejects if a required input symbol is blank or the pair cannot be encoded by the pairwise Boolean symbol encoding; otherwise it parses the circuit description, checks gate arguments and gate arities, evaluates each gate, and eventually emits the computed Boolean. During parsing, malformed encodings are rejected; while copying, if $e$ is true, any additional input symbol after the copied description causes rejection, whereas if $e$ is false the machine may stop copying at that point.
hypotheses_covered: A machine state, an optional input Boolean, and the scanned symbols on two work tapes
caveat: The transition is specified by a detailed state-by-state table in the formal statement; this summary describes its overall behavior but omits some intermediate tape-management transitions.
